def loss_amount(actual_cost, sale_amount):
    """Write a function that gives loss amount if the given amount has loss else return none.

    A loss occurs when the actual cost exceeds the sale amount: buying
    at ``actual_cost`` and selling at a lower ``sale_amount`` loses
    ``actual_cost - sale_amount``. For example, ``loss_amount(1500, 1200)``
    is ``300``. If the sale amount is greater than or equal to the
    actual cost there is no loss, so return ``None``.
    """
    if actual_cost > sale_amount:
        return actual_cost - sale_amount
    return None
